info.name: NL Design Profiles
info.summary: Select bounded Dutch public-sector profile projections in Nextcloud
info.description:
This app leaves a new installation on native Nextcloud until an administrator selects a packaged design profile. It maps only that profile's font and primary interaction roles to a bounded Nextcloud core CSS surface.
The package inventories 40 profile snapshots. Only the 8 records carrying the statically validated nextcloud-core-v1 projection are selectable in administration settings.
This is the core profile plane. Theming app fields are surfaced separately as manual-only bridge guidance until a compatibility driver is explicitly version-verified, recovery-tested, and enabled.
